findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Diagnóstico sem custo" above "24"; "No ar em fases, não em PDF" above "3"; "Grupos que hoje fecham o mês em planilha" above "Rentabilidade e DRE gerencial"; "Redes, associações e grupos com várias casas" above "Consolidação e BI de rede"; "Entregue por fases, de maio a agosto de 2026" above "Portal de operações, fiscal e consolidaç"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "innovadapt · painel da operação", "no ar", "Leads no mês", "351"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.
Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (42px, 58px, 646px, 1114px, 757px, 884px, 399px); the three most used hold only 56% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Painel mostra o que aconteceu. Sistema faz acont" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Um dono. Nenhuma camada entre você e quem decide" (screen 6, 38% hidden); "As objeções, respondidas antes da reunião" (screen 7, 33% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 7 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
